title: The Threat and the Answer
art: The black smoke is the same whisper seen in the Garden; the brothers are figures of glow with no faces.
imagePrompt: A tense side two-shot on a storm-lit hilltop, the horizon cutting the frame in half and the storm filling the sky; on the right a figure of deep, smouldering red light leaning forward, dark smoke rising from its shoulders, a thin snake-like wisp of black smoke coiling around it with faint unreadable script; on the left a calm, steady figure of white light with open hands lowered, palms outward, refusing to fight; two stone altars between them. No faces, only glow.

beats.say: Envy burned in Qabil until his light turned red.
A thread of black smoke, the same that crept through the Garden, wound around his shoulders.
Habil lowered his open hands and would not fight.

verse.en: Indeed, Allah only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him].

beats.say: The wind rose with every word.

verse.en: If you should raise your hand against me to kill me - I shall not raise my hand against you to kill you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds.
